sources.entry: linked - Link your thoughts to days, distraction free. ![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]
linked - 🧾 Your daily journal app, diary or anything else to unclutter your mind. Let linked help you get focused by writing down what is in your mind on a daily basis.

summary.one_liner: linked is a free, open-source, distraction-free daily journaling app for macOS-style note taking, where you write thoughts into one entry per day.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you write as much as you want for each day, with support for text styles, todo lists, list blocks and code blocks. It has a search function that spans all days and keyboard shortcuts for moving between today, previous and next days and weeks, and opening search and settings. It comes in dark and light modes and offers multi-language support. Entries are stored as files in ~/Documents/linked, so the user keeps their own data. The README lists upcoming features: linking days together, a month overview, rating days, and syncing across devices. The project is built with Electron and run via yarn.
use_cases: writing todo lists and notes per day
notable: One entry per day, with files saved as plain files in ~/Documents/linked
Keyboard-driven navigation between days and weeks, plus search with Cmd/Ctrl+K
Dark and light modes and multi-language support
Listed in awesome-mac under Journaling and in open-source-mac-os-apps under Markdown
caveats: Sync across devices, month overview, and day linking are listed as upcoming, not available yet
Running from source requires Node v15+ and yarn; the README does not describe a packaged install beyond a download link
The README says the app will always be open source and free, and invites sponsorship or tips
